cover_headline: India Gold Demand Seen At Six-Year Low As Prices Weigh
facts: The World Gold Council estimates India's total gold demand in 2026 will fall to around 650 metric tons, the lowest since 2020
Gold demand fell 29% year-on-year to 162.5 metric tons in the September quarter, with jewellery purchases down 20% and investment demand down 40%
More than half of India's gold demand comes from rural areas, where jewellery is a traditional store of wealth for millions

end.headline: India Gold Demand Seen At Six-Year Low As Prices Weigh
end.line: The World Gold Council estimates India's 2026 demand will fall to around 650 metric tons, after September-quarter demand dropped 29% year-on-year to 162.5 tons.
